下方色带是三种光的混合。读数先把 sRGB 编码变成线性光，再按亮度权重相加。黑: The lower strip mixes all three colours. The readout decodes sRGB into linear light before applying luminance weights. Black turns emission off.
点一下像素阵列，记录触控位置。网格是电极结构示意；RGB 条纹不是原机子像素排布: Tap the pixel array to mark a touch. The electrode grid is schematic; these RGB stripes are not the original panel layout. The scan runs at 1/120 speed.
CPU 执行通用指令，GPU 并行处理图形，神经网络引擎加速特定计算。缓存和内存: The CPU executes general instructions, the GPU processes graphics in parallel, and the Neural Engine accelerates selected computations. Cache and memory keep data moving. This is not the original die layout.
每一级把 A、B 和上一级进位相加。画面从左边最低位开始；这是独立的真实逻辑计算: Each stage adds A, B and the incoming carry. The least significant bit starts at the left. This is a working independent logic circuit, not a reconstruction of A15.
物体靠近时，像面远离镜头。传感器没有位于像面上，光就形成一个小圆而不是一个点。自: As an object approaches, its image plane moves away from the lens. If the sensor misses that plane, a point spreads into a small circle. Autofocus motors move the lens elements.
光学采用理想薄透镜、参考焦距 4.2 mm 和固定 ƒ/1.6。像距差在场景中放: The model uses an ideal thin lens, a reference 4.2 mm focal length and fixed ƒ/1.6 aperture. Image-distance differences are enlarged 30 times. The ray diagram is schematic, not a trace through the original aspherical lens.
绿色粒子表示电解质里的锂离子，金色粒子表示外电路电子。充电时两者方向反转。粒子数: Green particles represent lithium ions in the electrolyte; gold particles represent electrons in the external circuit. Both reverse during charging. Particle counts, speeds and layer thicknesses are illustrative.
参考电池 12 Wh；各系统功率与充电曲线为教学参数，不预测真实 iPhone: Reference cell: 12 Wh. Subsystem powers and the charging envelope are teaching parameters, not predictions of real iPhone battery life.
点一下比特。0 和 1 使用相差半个周期的载波相位。这是 BPSK 原理实验；真: Flip a bit. Zero and one use carrier phases half a cycle apart. This BPSK experiment illustrates a principle; real cellular systems add coding, multicarrier operation and more complex modulation.
自由空间、20 MHz 带宽、23 dBm 发射、15 dBi 基站增益、7 d: Free space, 20 MHz bandwidth, 23 dBm transmit power, 15 dBi base-station gain and 7 dB noise figure. No obstructions or interference. Capacity is a theoretical bound, not a measured data rate.
电磁力驱动质量来回运动，弹簧把它拉回，阻尼消耗能量。在同样的驱动力下，接近共振频: Electromagnetic force drives the mass, springs restore it and damping dissipates energy. With the same drive force, motion grows near resonance.
2 g 移动质量、175 Hz 共振、Q=6 均为参考参数，非 Taptic E: A 2 g mass, 175 Hz resonance and Q=6 are reference parameters, not Taptic Engine measurements. Motion runs at 1/100 speed with displacement enlarged 12 times. The curve is the steady-state driven damped oscillator.

外形尺寸与公开配置参照 Apple iPhone 13。内部是原创程序化教学模型: External dimensions and published specifications refer to Apple iPhone 13. The original procedural interior is a teaching model. Part layout, geometry and explosion paths do not come from production CAD and are not repair instructions.
八位加法器、薄透镜、sRGB 线性光混合、能量守恒、自由空间链路和受迫振子都由画: The eight-bit adder, thin lens, sRGB light mixing, energy balance, free-space link and driven oscillator are calculated from the displayed inputs. Limits appear beside each instrument.
这是一张可探索的系统地图，不声称覆盖手机全部工程细节。触控网格、芯片功能区、离子: This is an explorable system map, not every engineering detail of a phone. Touch grids, chip blocks, ion particles and data pulses illustrate mechanisms.
所有场景几何、材质和图表均为原创生成，无第三方拆机照片或模型。完整参数与引用见世: All geometry, materials and plots are generated for this world. No third-party teardown photos or models are used. Parameters and references are in SOURCES.md alongside the source.
拖动拆解程度，旋转到背面。点选电池、芯片或镜头，沿着拍照、游戏、通话的路径追踪数: Adjust the explosion and orbit to the back. Select the battery, a chip or a lens; follow the paths used for photos, games and calls.
单独关闭红、绿或蓝，观察微观子像素和下方混合色。再点一下屏幕，留下触控位置。: Turn red, green or blue off individually. Compare the microscopic subpixels with the mixed colour below. Tap the screen to mark a touch.
看一次进位走完八位: Follow a carry across eight bits
选择两个输入数，从最低位看起。每一级的进位都进入下一级，最后得到九位结果。: Choose two numbers and start at the least significant bit. Each carry feeds the next stage, producing a nine-bit result.
让光，准确落在传感器上: Bring the image onto the sensor
改变物体距离，再调焦。计算出的成像平面与传感器平面重合时，弥散圈接近零。: Move the object and refocus. When the calculated image plane and sensor plane coincide, the circle of confusion approaches zero.
同时改变亮度、计算和无线负载。接上充电器，看锂离子与外电路电子反向移动。: Change brightness, processing and radio loads together. Connect the charger and watch ions and circuit electrons reverse.
在无线实验里翻转几个比特，再去触觉实验寻找共振峰。所有这些系统都在同一部手机里协: Flip a few bits in the radio lab, then find the resonance peak in haptics. All these systems work together inside one phone.
中框承受弯曲载荷，边缘的绝缘分段让金属边框可以参与天线工作。: The frame carries bending loads. Insulating breaks allow metal frame segments to act as antennas.
玻璃背板让无线充电的交变磁场穿过，金属背板会产生显著涡流。: Glass lets the alternating magnetic field of wireless charging pass through. A metal back would develop substantial eddy currents.
有机发光层在电流驱动下发光。红、绿、蓝子像素的光在眼中混合；黑色可以通过关闭发光: Current makes the organic emissive layers glow. Red, green and blue subpixels mix in your vision; black can be produced by turning emission off.
交叉电极构成感应网格。手指改变局部电容，控制器从多条电极的变化估计触点位置。: Crossed electrodes form a sensing grid. A finger changes local capacitance; the controller estimates position from changes across the electrodes.
透明盖板保护显示和触控层。这里厚度、涂层和拆解间距为教学排布。: The transparent cover protects display and touch layers. Thicknesses, coatings and exploded spacing are teaching choices.
锂离子在电解质中移动，电子通过外电路做功。电源实验按参考 12 Wh 电池计算，: Lithium ions move through electrolyte while electrons do work in the external circuit. The power lab uses a reference 12 Wh cell, not a measurement of this phone.
铜互连把电源、处理器、存储和无线芯片连接起来。教学布局省略走线层叠与真实布线规则: Copper interconnects join power, processing, storage and radio chips. This teaching layout omits the real layer stack and routing rules.
iPhone 13 的 A15 含 6 核 CPU、4 核 GPU 和 16 核: iPhone 13 A15 has a 6-core CPU, 4-core GPU and 16-core Neural Engine. Functional block positions and areas in the enlarged view are illustrative.
DRAM 暂存正在处理的数据，需要持续刷新；它和长期保存照片的闪存不同。位置与封: DRAM holds working data and must be refreshed. It differs from flash, which retains photos without power. Package position is a teaching separation.
闪存用存储单元的电荷状态表示数据。断电后仍能保存，但写入和擦除需要专门的控制过程: Flash stores data in charge states. It retains them without power, with dedicated control for programming and erasing.
电池的一种电压经过转换和调节，变成处理器、屏幕等各自需要的多条电源轨。: Conversion and regulation turn one battery voltage into the multiple supply rails needed by the processor, screen and other loads.
数字基带进行编码和调制；射频通路把信号搬到载波频率，经过功率放大后送到天线。: Digital baseband encodes and modulates data. RF circuitry shifts it to the carrier, amplifies it and feeds the antenna.
短距离无线连接使用独立的射频通路，与蜂窝系统分工协作。: Short-range links use their own radio paths alongside the cellular system.
原机规格：1200 万像素、ƒ/1.6、传感器位移式防抖。这里的多片镜组是原创光: Published specifications: 12 megapixels, ƒ/1.6 and sensor-shift stabilisation. The multi-element lens here is an original optical illustration.
原机规格：1200 万像素、ƒ/2.4、120° 视野。两颗摄像头提供不同视角，: Published specifications: 12 megapixels, ƒ/2.4 and a 120° field of view. The two cameras provide different perspectives.
半导体 LED 把电能变成短时照明；亮度、色温与曝光一起影响成像。: Semiconductor LEDs turn electrical energy into short illumination pulses. Brightness and colour temperature interact with exposure.
红外照明、点阵投影与红外相机参与深度感知。这里不复制 Face ID 的专有算法: Infrared illumination, a dot projector and an infrared camera support depth sensing. This does not reproduce Face ID algorithms or its dot pattern.
电流经过线圈，磁场推动振膜，振膜带动空气。: Current through a coil creates a magnetic force that moves a diaphragm and the surrounding air.
小型声学腔体与振膜配合，把电信号转换为声压变化。: A small acoustic enclosure works with a diaphragm to turn electrical signals into pressure variations.
线圈、电磁力、弹簧和移动质量产生触感。实验台使用受迫阻尼振子，不代表原机实测参数: A coil, electromagnetic force, springs and moving mass create tactile feedback. The lab uses a driven damped oscillator, not measured original-device parameters.
外部电源经过接口和保护电路进入电源管理系统；这里显示简化的供电路径。: External power passes through the connector and protection circuitry into power management. Only a simplified power path is shown.
变化的磁通在线圈中感应电压；整流与调节后为设备供电。磁铁帮助对准，不是能量来源。: Changing magnetic flux induces voltage in the coil. Rectification and regulation supply the device. Magnets align the coils; they do not supply energy.
导电屏蔽盖抑制不希望出现的电磁耦合，同时与散热结构协作。: Conductive shields reduce unwanted electromagnetic coupling and work with the thermal structure.
柔性铜走线把显示数据、电源和控制信号送到面板；弯曲形态是教学展示。: Flexible copper traces carry display data, power and control signals to the panel. The bend is a display arrangement.
导体上的交变电流与周围空间的电磁场耦合。实际匹配网络与多天线分集没有在此完整求解: Alternating currents on conductors couple to electromagnetic fields in space. Actual matching networks and multi-antenna diversity are not fully solved here.
多条天线适应不同频段与握持状态。可视化波长和场强不能按这张拆解图的比例理解。: Multiple antennas support different bands and grip conditions. Visual wave sizes and field strengths are not to scale with the teardown.
一部手机，七套协作的系统。: One phone. Seven systems working together.
把电流，变成你眼前的颜色。: Turn current into the colours you see.
数十亿个开关，怎样完成一次运算。: Billions of switches. One operation at a time.
光穿过镜头，落成一张照片。: Light passes through glass and becomes an image.
所有的工作，都要付出能量。: Every task has an energy cost.
把一串数字，送进电磁波。: Put a stream of bits onto an electromagnetic wave.
一次清脆的触感，来自一块往复运动的质量。: A crisp tap starts with a moving mass.
